content:
kelly-peopleops: Quick Q&A: Exceptions to standard promo cadence (off-cycle, emergency retention, backfills). Drop edge cases.

adam-engmgr: We have a senior IC with an external offer asking to expedite. Can we do a same-month effective date and increase beyond band max?

kelly-peopleops: Expedite is allowed for retention. Steps: 1) manager fills expedited form, 2) include the external offer as evidence, 3) director + People Ops + Finance must sign. Anything that breaches band_max still needs comp committee sign-off (we're faster but not skipping approvals).

priya-ic: If Finance approves a one-time retention bonus instead of base increase, does that avoid comp committee?

kelly-peopleops: One-time retention bonuses are vendorized and usually need only manager + Finance sign-off, not comp committee. Document reason and duration. Bonuses do not change base comp or band placement.

adam-engmgr: Can we promise future leveling if candidate takes the retention bonus? Any legalese?

kelly-peopleops: Avoid guaranteed future promises. Use conditional language: "We will review leveling on [date] contingent on impact metrics". If you want a binding pledge, Legal must approve wording.

finance-bot: Note: expedited base increases processed same-day require a Finance acknowledgement and may trigger retro calculations if past payroll cutoff.

priya-ic: What about title-only adjustments for career progression without comp? Are those visible in Workday to others?

kelly-peopleops: Title-only changes still create a Workday action; visibility follows our org settings. Mention "title-only" in the packet to avoid confusion. Calibration still applies for title changes.

adam-engmgr: If a manager wants to split a >15% increase into smaller tranches to avoid comp committee, is that allowed?

kelly-peopleops: No stitching to circumvent committee. Any planned cumulative >15% within a 12-month window will be routed to comp committee. Be transparent in the packet.

priya-ic: For promotions that change equity target, can we grant an interim RSU top-up?

kelly-peopleops: Interim grants can be requested; approvals require Head of People + Head of Finance for off-cycle grants. Include vesting schedule and rationale.

kelly-peopleops: TL;DR: expedited and off-cycle are possible but require the same guardrails (evidence, director + People Ops sign-off, Finance/comp committee when thresholds crossed). DM me drafts and we'll prioritize review.
